facts.statement: Mnyamawamtuka was placed in the Titanosauria in 2019.

facts.statement: It is debated whether Mnyamawamtuka belongs outside the Lithostrotia or in a basal position within them as a sister species of Malawisaurus.
facts.quote: Mnyamawamtuka was sometimes recovered outside of the Lithostrotia. Alternatively, it was positioned in a basal position within the lithostrotians, as sister species of Malawisaurus.

facts.statement: Mnyamawamtuka lived during the middle Cretaceous, between 110 and 100 million years ago, from the Albian to the Cenomanian, in what is now Africa.

facts.statement: The holotype specimen was found in a layer of the Mtuka Member of the Galula Formation, dating from the Aptian to Cenomanian, very likely between 110 and 100 million years ago.
